payload.instruction: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

outcome.description: Move the source mug to the right of the headphones.
outcome.target: The mug present in the source image, moved so it is positioned to the right of the headphones. A newly introduced or duplicated mug on the right does not fulfill the request unless evidence establishes it is the source mug.
outcome.reference: Use the source and edited images to assess the source mug's identity, correspondence, and position relative to the headphones. Do not assume that a mug appearing on the right is the source mug.

check.question: What visual evidence supports correspondence of the source mug and headphones to objects in the edited image, and what does it show about their positions or movement?
check.complete_when: Record visual evidence for identifying the source mug and headphones and matching them to edited objects, including distinguishing the source mug from any additional mugs. Note relevant position or movement evidence and any uncertainty; do not treat uncertain identity alone as proof that no movement occurred.
check.partial_when: Not applicable; this check records support evidence only and does not assess fulfillment.
check.absent_when: Not applicable; this check records support evidence only and does not assess fulfillment.
check.unknown_when: There is no usable visual evidence to assess object identity, correspondence, or relevant positions.

response.content: {"status":"partial","evidence":"The source has one light-blue mug left of the black headphones. In the edited image, the headphones remain recognizable near the center, and a mug is now to their right; however, that right-hand mug is white, unlike the source mug. A light-blue blurred shape remains on the left, while another white mug appears left of the headphones, so the source mug’s correspondence and movement are uncertain; the right-side mug alone does not establish that the source mug was moved."}
